```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(yaml)
library(dplyr)

helper_candidates <- c(
  file.path(getwd(), "helpers_workflow.R"),
  file.path(getwd(), "inst", "scripts", "helpers_workflow.R"),
  system.file("scripts", "helpers_workflow.R", package = "metpipe")
)
helper_candidates <- helper_candidates[file.exists(helper_candidates)]
if (length(helper_candidates) == 0) stop("Cannot locate helpers_workflow.R")
source(helper_candidates[[1]], local = TRUE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE, include = TRUE)

```

## Inputs

```{r inputs}

cfg         <- wf_read_yaml_config(params$config, label = "params$config")
meta_pos    <- wf_as_meta_df(cfg$meta_pos)
meta_neg    <- wf_as_meta_df(cfg$meta_neg)
run.pos     <- wf_as_flag(cfg$run.pos)
run.neg     <- wf_as_flag(cfg$run.neg)
path_result <- wf_cfg_required(cfg, "path_result")

# Parse overlap sample names (comma-separated)
overlap_names <- if (!wf_is_blank(params$overlap_by_name)) {
  trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(params$overlap_by_name), ",", fixed = TRUE)))
} else {
  character(0)
}

# Parse overlap sample types and resolve to sample names via Sample.type column
overlap_type_names <- if (!wf_is_blank(params$overlap_sample_types)) {
  types <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(params$overlap_sample_types), ",", fixed = TRUE)))
  pos_by_type <- if (!is.null(meta_pos) && "Sample.type" %in% colnames(meta_pos))
    meta_pos$Sample[meta_pos$Sample.type %in% types] else character(0)
  neg_by_type <- if (!is.null(meta_neg) && "Sample.type" %in% colnames(meta_neg))
    meta_neg$Sample[meta_neg$Sample.type %in% types] else character(0)
  unique(c(pos_by_type, neg_by_type))
} else {
  character(0)
}

overlap_names <- unique(c(overlap_names, overlap_type_names))

# Parse batch_assignments: R expression that evaluates to a list of index vectors
# e.g. "list(1:30, 31:50)"
if (wf_is_blank(params$batch_assignments)) stop("batch_assignments is required")
batch_assignments <- tryCatch(
  eval(parse(text = as.character(params$batch_assignments))),
  error = function(e) stop("Cannot parse batch_assignments: ", conditionMessage(e))
)
if (!is.list(batch_assignments)) {
  stop("batch_assignments must evaluate to a list, e.g. list(1:30, 31:50)")
}
n_batches <- length(batch_assignments)

cat("Config:              ", params$config, "\n")
cat("Overlap by name:     ", length(overlap_names) - length(overlap_type_names), "\n")
cat("Overlap by type:     ", length(overlap_type_names), "\n")
cat("Overlap total:       ", length(overlap_names), "\n")
cat("Batches:             ", n_batches, "\n")

```

## Sample partitioning

```{r partition}

pos_samples <- if (run.pos && !is.null(meta_pos)) meta_pos$Sample else character(0)
neg_samples <- if (run.neg && !is.null(meta_neg)) meta_neg$Sample else character(0)

# Warn about overlap names not found in either mode
missing_ov <- overlap_names[!overlap_names %in% union(pos_samples, neg_samples)]
if (length(missing_ov) > 0)
  warning("overlap_by_name: not found in pos or neg — ",
          paste(missing_ov, collapse = ", "))

pos_non_ov <- pos_samples[!pos_samples %in% overlap_names]
neg_non_ov <- neg_samples[!neg_samples %in% overlap_names]

# Shared non-overlap samples (pos order preserved)
shared   <- pos_non_ov[pos_non_ov %in% neg_non_ov]
pos_only <- pos_non_ov[!pos_non_ov %in% neg_non_ov]
neg_only <- neg_non_ov[!neg_non_ov %in% pos_non_ov]

if (length(pos_only) > 0)
  message(length(pos_only), " pos-only samples will be placed in a separate batch.")
if (length(neg_only) > 0)
  message(length(neg_only), " neg-only samples will be placed in a separate batch.")

# Validate indices against the shared sample pool
all_idx <- unlist(batch_assignments)
if (length(all_idx) > 0) {
  if (length(shared) == 0) stop("No shared (pos+neg) non-overlap samples available to assign")
  if (any(all_idx < 1) || any(all_idx > length(shared)))
    stop("batch_assignments index out of range [1, ", length(shared), "]")
}

cat("Overlap samples:           ", length(overlap_names), "\n")
cat("Shared non-overlap (pos):  ", length(shared), "\n")
cat("Pos-only (extra batch):    ", length(pos_only), "\n")
cat("Neg-only (extra batch):    ", length(neg_only), "\n")

```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}

# Convert a filtered data.frame back to the column-list format used in YAML
df_to_yaml_cols <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  as.list(df)
}

# Return rows for overlap samples first (original order), then batch-specific samples
filter_meta_ordered <- function(meta, ov_names, specific_names) {
  if (is.null(meta)) return(NULL)
  ov_rows <- meta[meta$Sample %in% ov_names,       , drop = FALSE]
  sp_rows <- meta[meta$Sample %in% specific_names,  , drop = FALSE]
  res <- rbind(ov_rows, sp_rows)
  if (nrow(res) == 0) NULL else res
}

# Select raw file paths matching a filtered meta data.frame (preserves meta row order)
raw_files_for_meta <- function(all_raw, meta) {
  if (is.null(meta) || nrow(meta) == 0 || is.null(all_raw)) return(NULL)
  lut     <- setNames(unlist(all_raw), basename(unlist(all_raw)))
  matched <- lut[meta$File.name]
  unname(matched[!is.na(matched)])
}

# Build a batch-specific config list from the master config
make_batch_config <- function(cfg, ov_names, specific_names, new_pr) {
  meta_pos_src <- wf_as_meta_df(cfg$meta_pos)
  meta_neg_src <- wf_as_meta_df(cfg$meta_neg)

  mp <- if (wf_as_flag(cfg$run.pos)) filter_meta_ordered(meta_pos_src, ov_names, specific_names) else NULL
  mn <- if (wf_as_flag(cfg$run.neg)) filter_meta_ordered(meta_neg_src, ov_names, specific_names) else NULL

  rp <- !is.null(mp) && nrow(mp) > 0
  rn <- !is.null(mn) && nrow(mn) > 0

  new_cfg <- cfg
  new_cfg$path_result             <- new_pr
  new_cfg$path_temp               <- paste0(new_pr, "/temp")
  new_cfg$run.pos                 <- rp
  new_cfg$run.neg                 <- rn
  new_cfg$meta_pos                <- if (rp) df_to_yaml_cols(mp) else NULL
  new_cfg$meta_neg                <- if (rn) df_to_yaml_cols(mn) else NULL
  new_cfg$raw_files_pos           <- if (rp) as.list(raw_files_for_meta(cfg$raw_files_pos, mp)) else NULL
  new_cfg$raw_files_neg           <- if (rn) as.list(raw_files_for_meta(cfg$raw_files_neg, mn)) else NULL
  new_cfg$mzmine_peaktable_pos    <- paste0(new_pr, "/pos/pos_full_feature_table.csv")
  new_cfg$mzmine_peaktable_neg    <- paste0(new_pr, "/neg/neg_full_feature_table.csv")
  new_cfg$path_peaktable_pos      <- paste0(new_pr, "/peaktable_pos.xlsx")
  new_cfg$path_peaktable_neg      <- paste0(new_pr, "/peaktable_neg.xlsx")
  new_cfg$path_peaktable_istd_pos <- paste0(new_pr, "/peaktable_istd_pos.xlsx")
  new_cfg$path_peaktable_istd_neg <- paste0(new_pr, "/peaktable_istd_neg.xlsx")
  new_cfg$rds_qc_is_pos           <- paste0(new_pr, "/data/QC_IS_pos.rds")
  new_cfg$rds_qc_is_neg           <- paste0(new_pr, "/data/QC_IS_neg.rds")
  new_cfg$rds_datalist            <- paste0(new_pr, "/datalist.rds")
  new_cfg$path_datatable          <- paste0(new_pr, "/datatable.xlsx")
  new_cfg
}

```

## Batch config files

```{r write_configs}

base_name    <- basename(path_result)
summary_rows <- vector("list", n_batches)

for (i in seq_len(n_batches)) {
  specific <- shared[batch_assignments[[i]]]
  new_pr   <- normalizePath(
    file.path(path_result, paste0(base_name, "_b", i)),
    winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
  )
  bcfg <- make_batch_config(cfg, overlap_names, specific, new_pr)
  dir.create(new_pr, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  out  <- file.path(new_pr, paste0("config_b", i, ".yml"))
  writeLines(yaml::as.yaml(bcfg), out)

  n_pos <- if (!is.null(bcfg$meta_pos)) length(bcfg$meta_pos[[1]]) else 0L
  n_neg <- if (!is.null(bcfg$meta_neg)) length(bcfg$meta_neg[[1]]) else 0L
  summary_rows[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Batch          = paste0("b", i),
    Config         = basename(out),
    Overlap        = length(overlap_names),
    Batch_specific = length(specific),
    Total_pos      = n_pos,
    Total_neg      = n_neg,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Extra batch for samples present in only one ionization mode
if (length(pos_only) > 0 || length(neg_only) > 0) {
  ie        <- n_batches + 1L
  unmatched <- unique(c(pos_only, neg_only))
  new_pr    <- normalizePath(
    file.path(path_result, paste0(base_name, "_b", ie)),
    winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
  )
  bcfg <- make_batch_config(cfg, overlap_names, unmatched, new_pr)
  dir.create(new_pr, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  out  <- file.path(new_pr, paste0("config_b", ie, ".yml"))
  writeLines(yaml::as.yaml(bcfg), out)

  n_pos <- if (!is.null(bcfg$meta_pos)) length(bcfg$meta_pos[[1]]) else 0L
  n_neg <- if (!is.null(bcfg$meta_neg)) length(bcfg$meta_neg[[1]]) else 0L
  summary_rows[[ie]] <- data.frame(
    Batch          = paste0("b", ie, " (pos/neg-only)"),
    Config         = basename(out),
    Overlap        = length(overlap_names),
    Batch_specific = length(unmatched),
    Total_pos      = n_pos,
    Total_neg      = n_neg,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
knitr::kable(
  summary_df,
  caption = "Batch summary",
  col.names = c("Batch", "Config file", "Overlap samples",
                "Batch-specific samples", "Pos total", "Neg total")
)

```
